ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* This Procedure Checks Out Duplicate Records...
*/
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50); 
 temp_v_apos VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:apos,'N');
 temp_v_aneg VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:aneg,'N');
 temp_v_bpos VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:bpos,'N');
 temp_v_bneg VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:bneg,'N');
 temp_v_abpos VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:abpos,'N');
 temp_v_abneg VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:abneg,'N');
 temp_v_opos VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:opos,'N');
 temp_v_oneg VARCHAR2(1) := nvl(:oneg,'N');
 temp_unit_scheme_type varchar2(1) := :unit_scheme_type;
 temp_label_reqd varchar2(1) := :rh_label_flag;
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(4);
 BEGIN
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 WHILE :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 LOOP
 IF temp_v_apos = nvl(:apos,'N') AND
 temp_v_aneg = nvl(:aneg,'N') AND
 temp_v_bpos = nvl(:bpos,'N') AND
 temp_v_bneg = nvl(:bneg,'N') AND
 temp_v_abpos = nvl(:abpos,'N') AND
 temp_v_abneg = nvl(:abneg,'N') AND
 temp_v_opos = nvl(:opos,'N') AND
 temp_v_oneg = nvl(:oneg,'N') AND
 temp_unit_scheme_type = :unit_scheme_type AND
 temp_label_reqd = :rh_label_flag AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no 
 THEN
 first_record;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 END;
END;
